name: AE Mail
migrationPolicy: Workload is an immutable image release, not a mounted code tree. Keep mountedRelease.enabled false. Image or compose changes rebuild the runtime only. Mail-data volumes stay outside this recipe. A Mail change must never deploy Public or Staff code.
rollbackPolicy: Roll back by restoring the previous runtime image pointer. Do not flip a mounted current symlink. Unhealthy new image is not left serving.
